summary: Resource Center of Dallas, an LGBTQIA+ health and wellness provider in North Texas, disclosed that an unauthorized party accessed its network between February 4 and 12, 2026, affecting 12,490 people. Names, dates of birth, medical and health insurance information, financial account information, Social Security numbers and other identifiers were exposed. The investigation finished July 2, 2026.
